title: Daily Devotional #10
paragraphs: Today, I spent some time reading Matthew chapter 10, and it really spoke to me. The chapter is all about your call to your disciples to go out and preach the gospel, heal the sick, and drive out demons. As I read, I was struck by how much trust and faith you placed in your disciples to carry out this important work.

One verse that particularly stood out to me was Matthew 10:16, where you say, "I am sending you out like sheep among wolves. Therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves." This verse reminds me that as your follower, I must always be prepared to face adversity and opposition. But at the same time, I must also maintain my purity and innocence in the face of temptation and sin.

I also love how you encourage your disciples to not worry about what they will say when they are brought before authorities. You tell them that the Holy Spirit will give them the words to say. This is such a powerful reminder that I too should rely on the Holy Spirit to guide my words and actions, especially when I am in difficult or challenging situations.

Finally, I was struck by the urgency of your message in this chapter. You tell your disciples to go out and preach, heal, and drive out demons because the harvest is plentiful but the workers are few. This is a reminder that there are still so many people in the world who need to hear the good news of your love and salvation. It's up to us, your followers, to share that message with the world.

As I go about my day today, I pray that I will be like your disciples in Matthew 10 - faithful, obedient, and bold in sharing your message with others. Help me to rely on the Holy Spirit for wisdom and guidance, and to never lose sight of the urgency of this task. Thank you for your love and grace, and for the privilege of being called to serve you.
